  Suna hai Madina suna hai Madina

  Aashur ko aaya ye Khat-e-Fatima Sughra
  Suna hai Madina
  Kab laut ke ghar aao ge ya Shaah-e-Madina
  Suna hai Madina

  1
  Maiṅ dar pe khari rehti huṅ ek aas lagaaye
  Bhaiya nahiṅ aaye
  Shikwa nahiṅ Akbar se hai taqdir se shikwa
  Suna hai Madina

  2
  Do din se mere halq se paani nahiṅ utra
  Qurbaan ho Sughra
  Dil kehta hai pardes meiṅ tum pyaase ho baba
  Suna hai Madina

  3
  Pardes meiṅ bhaiya ho agar byaah tumhaara
  Armaan hai mera
  Baandhe hue sehra meri turbat pe bhi aana
  Suna hai Madina

  4
  Maiṅ raatoṅ ko soti huṅ to jaag uthti huṅ aksar
  Kya baat hai aakhir
  Bikhraaye hue baal nazar aati hai Zehra
  Suna hai Madina

  5
  Ek shishe meiṅ kuchh khaak liye phirti hai daadi
  Aur karti hai zaari
  Mazlum Husaina mere mazlum Husaina
  Suna hai Madina

  6
  Amma ki bhari god rahe maang na ujre
  Khaaliq se dua hai
  Ya Rab mere beshir ka aabaad ho jhula
  Suna hai Madina

  7
  Khat parh ke Husain Ibn-e-Ali khub sa roye
  Aur sar ko jhukaaye
  Qaasid ke qarib rakh diya ek nanha sa laasha
  Suna hai Madina

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/suna-hai-madina.md')
original = p.read_bytes()
opening, yaml, body = original.decode().split('---\\n', 2)
roman_start = 'romanLyrics: |-\\n'
metadata, roman = yaml.split(roman_start, 1)
edits = {
    'Suna hai Madina': 'Sunaa hai Madina',
    'suna hai Madina': 'sunaa hai Madina',
    'ye Khat-e-Fatima': 'ye khat-e-Fatima',
    'ek aas': 'ik aas',
    'Ek shishe': 'Ik shishe',
    'Amma ki': 'Ammaaṅ ki',
    'ka aabaad ho jhula': 'ka aabaad ho jhulaa',
    'ek nanha sa': 'ik nanha sa',
}
for old, new in edits.items():
    assert old in roman, old
    roman = roman.replace(old, new)
updated = '---\\n'.join((opening, metadata + roman_start + roman, body)).encode()
assert updated.split(b'---\\n', 2)[2] == original.split(b'---\\n', 2)[2]
source_blocks = body.strip().split('\\n\\n')
roman_blocks = roman.strip('\\n').split('\\n\\n')
assert len(source_blocks) == len(roman_blocks) == 9
for source_block, roman_block in zip(source_blocks, roman_blocks):
    assert len(source_block.splitlines()) == len(roman_block.splitlines())
p.write_bytes(updated)
PY

from pathlib import Path

    'suna hai Madina': 'sunaa hai Madina',
    'ye Khat-e-Fatima': 'ye khat-e-Fatima',
    'ek aas': 'ik aas',
    'Ek shishe': 'Ik shishe',
    'Amma ki': 'Ammaaṅ ki',
    'ka aabaad ho jhula': 'ka aabaad ho jhulaa',
    'ek nanha sa': 'ik nanha sa',
}.items():
    assert old in roman, old
    roman = roman.replace(old, new)

roman_blocks = roman.strip('\\n').split('\\n\\n')

item.text: Audited the Roman transliteration verse by verse in [suna-hai-madina.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/3/workspaces/53807573abb942d5a884e7569db3b690/src/data/lyrics/suna-hai-madina.md). The opening and all seven numbered stanzas align. Human editorial sign-off remains pending.
